description.zh: 分子是原子连成的团：物理变化只改变分子的位置与间距，化学变化拆开分子、让原子重组成新分子，原子的种类和总数不变。仅适用于分子型物质的教学模型。
description.en: A molecule is a cluster of bonded atoms: a physical change only moves molecules, while a chemical change tears them apart and regroups the same atoms into new molecules, keeping atom kinds and totals. A teaching model for molecular substances only.

reason.zh: 水通电和甲烷燃烧中，分子的种类与个数都变了，但各元素的原子总数始终不变。
reason.en: In water electrolysis and methane burning the kinds and counts of molecules change, yet the total number of atoms of each element never does.

title.zh: 水烧开和水通电有什么本质区别？
title.en: What is the real difference between boiling water and electrolysing it?
